messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands with her back to the camera, briefly raises one hand to her hair, then places a hand on her hip and shifts her weight while facing the water.","camera":"A vertical medium-to-full shot from behind that slowly pulls back to reveal her full body and the wet stone platform.","clothing":"A cream romper with a pink, yellow, and green floral print, three-quarter sleeves, a low open back, and pink platform sandals.","hair_color":"Black","hairstyle":"Dark hair styled into a high top bun plus two low side buns at the nape.","identity":"A slim woman with a medium-brown complexion, seen from behind, with a narrow waist and long legs.","scene":"An outdoor stone terrace beside a calm blue sea under a clear sky, with rocks and a wooden post near the water's edge."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman now briefly raises one hand toward her head/hair and then places a hand on her hip while standing and shifting weight. Her head is not clearly lowered, and no hand is visibly resting on her forehead. The original seaside scene, floral romper, sandals, and rear camera framing are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, while preserving identity, clothing, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the brief hand-to-head motion was intended to represent the requested forehead pose.
unexpected_changes: The person's hairstyle appears altered, with an additional high top bun visible in the output.
